_help: Startup page (sponsors.py). Up to 4 slots; an empty slot shows 'Your ad here'. Each slot: name, text, url (optional), image (optional: a PNG, path from this folder), image_dark (optional, dark theme), button (optional: a button with the globe replaces the url line; sends = what it sends), until (optional YYYY-MM-DD: the slot is empty after that day). heading: the title over the slots (default SPONSORED). contact: shown under empty slots.
